notes.title: The Disgaea 4 Complete+ PC Network Features are finally here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

You thought we were forgetting something huh?

Pirates and Ministers and Netherbattles, oh my! Check out a horde of new network features with the latest update for Disgaea 4 Complete+!

The following features are now available:
- Custom maps
- Pirate Duels
- Cabinet Ministers
- Netherbattles
- Ranking System

Also, don't miss out on the limited time sale, and save 40% on this HL-raising RPG!

Hope everyone's had a safe and healthy start to 2021!

notes.title: Disgaea 4 Complete+ is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Heyo! Hope y’all are staying safe and doing well! I’m just here to let y’all know that Disgaea 4 Complete+ is coming to PC!

Valvatorez, a former tyrant turned Prinny instructor, must bring down the corrupt powers that rule over Hades and save all Prinnykind... with ruthless compassion! Everything you need to kick off your fiery cam-pain is here, including insane strategic action, a darkly humorous cast of characters, and of course, PLENTY OF SARDINES!!

It’s coming this fall, so be sure to visit the Steam page to watch the announcement trailer and add Disgaea 4 Complete+ to your wishlist!

Again, I hope everyone is staying healthy!
- Daniel
